Nothing in the diff shows that a suppressed type with an ordinary contract violation, such as a public member without [Key] (MsgPack004), now gets its diagnostic. interpretations.label: A
interpretations.summary: For SuppressSourceGeneration types, the analyzer reports only the contract rules that matter for run-time (dynamic) serialization: MsgPack003, 004, 005, 012 and 015.
